Version 1.07 Notes
- Adjusted the stamina reduction value of attacks when boost effect wears off during transformation.

Version 1.06 Notes
- Added data for Resurrection 'F' pack - Added World Tournament functionality - Increased level cap to 99 - Added new chat phrases - Added new Event Quests - Fixed bugs relating to knockback combos online - Rebalanced several skills - Rebalanced several Z-souls

Version 1.05 Notes
- Added data for additional costumes

Version 1.04 Notes
- Added data for Dragon Ball GT Pack 2 - Increased level cap to 85 - Tutorials can now be reconfirmed - Changed spawn location after finishing Parallel Quests - When disconnected from the Single Lobby, users are now taken to the Offline lobby - Made gathering Dragon Balls easier - Added NPC near News Board - Fixed effect issue with Shine Attack skill - Fixed some text issues

Version 1.03 Notes
The effect of the following Z Soul has been rectified.
Z Soul "Bwa-ha-ha, Thanks for the Energy"

Version 1.02 Notes
- Added data for Dragon Ball GT Pack 1 - Fixed English dialog and subtitle inconsistencies - Fixed issue where "Reversal" evaluation could not be earned in Quests - Fixed issue where some materials could not be earned in Quests - Fixed issue where player could not be revived from downed state - Implemented online event functionality

Version 1.01 Notes
- Fixed voice chat desync issue - Improved load times before Parallel Quests - Fixed crash issue during Parallel Quests - Improved in-game messages - Added English voice data for Jaco
